observed_in: Magic and Spellcasting System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the type of resources consumed when casting spells, which can vary from traditional mana points to alternative systems like hunger or cooldowns. Different implementations may introduce unique resource types that affect gameplay strategies and decision-making.
exclusion_criteria: Passive abilities that do not consume resources
inclusion_criteria: Resources can be numerical (e.g., mana points)
Resources can be physical (e.g., items consumed)
title: Resource Type Variability in Spellcasting
